verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents natural-language Q&A over your own data through its Query Agent, which runs agentic search over Weaviate Cloud collections, and it has built-in RAG in its query interface. That is a first-party way to get AI-generated answers from your data. However, the answer feature is marked Cloud only, and nothing shows proactive insights or suggestions being surfaced inside the product. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions, availability beyond Weaviate Cloud, in-depth docs on the insight experience, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get answers from your data by using a natural language prompt/question. Cloud only
Query Agent: Run agentic search over your Weaviate Cloud collections
It combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and reranking in a single query interface.
